integrity_notes: The original contribution is the five-type enumerator and multiplicity classification, not the classical code, Fano geometry, pair-metric bound, or existence of a binary length-eight pair-MDS code. A finite standard-library verifier accompanies a complete combinatorial proof. Independent mathematical priority/audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the binary [8,4,4] extended Hamming code and cyclic ordered coordinate positions; no generalization to higher lengths or actual hardware performance is asserted.
title: Five symbol-pair spectra of coordinate-ordered extended Hamming codes
